name: Katashina Shiori
source: Shiori is one of the many occupants living in the same apartment complex as the protagonist. Loves gossip and interesting stories. She finds out about the protagonist's affair with Yukari, and offered to introduce more women to him who wants to have children, if he will accept her one condition.
